name: ast-core-infra
description: Alchemy IaC for ast-core (isolated deploy tooling; Effect 4 per Alchemy peers; service stays on Effect 3).

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:worker
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && varlock run --inject vars -- pnpm exec alchemy deploy --config alchemy.run.ts
scripts.plan: pnpm run build && varlock run --inject vars -- pnpm exec alchemy deploy --dry-run --config alchemy.run.ts
